Scan & Evaluate OMRs with your Phone

Use the EzOMR App on any Android device to scan & evaluate provided OMRs instantly. 1.6 Million+ OMRs already scanned with EzOMR.

Your exam platform is used for adding the OMR key, adding App Users & Exam Analytics

New Exam Platform
Instant Results

EzOMR App can be used by multiple Examiners at once to quickly scan OMRs and generate Results

MCQs & Numericals

Single & Multi-correct MCQs with 3 4 5 or 6 options; Integer, Decimal & Negative Responses are supported

Optional Uploading

Can also upload scanned OMRs to your Account to be auto-evaluated instantly, using EzOMR is not mandatory

Create your custom Exam Platform & Upload Exam Key

Exam Keys are added in your Account. OMRs can also be downloaded from here, to be printed.
Your white-labeled web platform is created at institute-name.ezexam.in with your Logos and Colors where your Students & Staff have user accounts.

Your EZexam platform can even be hosted on your own web domain, contact us for more details

"This is a single Platform for OMR & Online Exams with integrated Analytics"

Scan OMRs with EzOMR App, auto-uploaded to your Account

Added Exam keys are sent to the App, OMRs are scanned into the Exam in the App.
Scanning & Evaluation is instant, perhaps taking a few seconds to focus the camera.

EzOMR logins are automatically created for Admins, any other App user can be added in the Platform to help with OMR scanning. EzOMR can be downloaded from the Google PlayStore here

"Instantly Scan & Evaluate OMRs with the EzOMR App"

Generate Analytics & Reports

Students even get their Corrected OMRs after the Exam to see their errors

In-Depth Analytics

Multi-page granular analytics provided for Students and Admins with deep information on each exam taken

OMRs as Needed

We provide you with PDFs of OMRs to print and conduct exams. All standard formats for JEE & NEET are available.

Data Confidentiality
